bobbin_air_fine.flow_to_y: fine: y = 1.2050 + 0.2100 * min(1, flow / 1) ** 0.85  (flow in L/min; reading at the top of the bobbin)
bobbin_air_fine.series: fine and coarse tubes of one gas carry the same flow: the fine bobbin rises 0..1 L/min then stays at its top; the coarse bobbin reads 1..10 L/min

bobbin_air_coarse.flow_to_y: coarse: y = 1.2050 + 0.2100 * min(1, flow / 10) ** 0.80  (flow in L/min; reading at the top of the bobbin)
bobbin_air_coarse.series: fine and coarse tubes of one gas carry the same flow: the fine bobbin rises 0..1 L/min then stays at its top; the coarse bobbin reads 1..10 L/min

knob_o2.rule: counter-clockwise (as the operator sees it, positive about +Z) opens; needle valve, about 3.5 turns closed to 10 L/min

knob_air.rule: counter-clockwise (as the operator sees it, positive about +Z) opens; needle valve, about 3.5 turns closed to 10 L/min

sevo_dial.rule: counter-clockwise (positive about +Z, as the operator sees it) raises the concentration; the index mark is fixed at 12 o'clock on sevo_bezel
sevo_dial.lock: sevo_lock (child of the dial) must be pressed (translate 0.002 m along -Z) to turn the dial off 0 toward the scale, or from 0 to T

apl_knob.rule: clockwise seen from above (negative about +Y) closes the valve: SP (fully open, <1 cmH2O) to 70 cmH2O; the knob's white pointer reads against apl_scale
apl_knob.above_70: between -280 and -300 deg the valve is fully closed (75+)

bag_vent_switch.labels: BAG at the back, VENT at the front on bag_vent_base

o2_flush.rule: press and hold: 35-75 L/min O2 to the common gas outlet (bypasses the vaporizers); springs back

root_transform: identity: the root `controls` is the machine-local origin
grip_pinch_note: hands_gloved.glb grip_pinch.L/.R: put the knob face center there, the knob axis along the grip +Z

O2 knob.mesh: anesthesia_machine_9 (material knob_oxygen): hide the whole mesh

air knob.mesh: anesthesia_machine_7 (material knob_air): hide the whole mesh

sevoflurane dial.mesh: anesthesia_machine_11 (material dial_sevoflurane): hide the whole mesh

colors: US: O2 green (fluted, larger, as required), air yellow, sevoflurane yellow; N2O tubes are included (static) so the flowmeter bank is complete; its blue knob stays the machine's own
